title: Linklet
summary: A campus marketplace for Kenyan university students, with verified accounts, searchable listings, real-time messaging, offers, ratings, and admin tools.
card: A campus marketplace built from zero: React on Vercel, Express and Socket.IO on Cloud Run, PostgreSQL on Supabase, and a messaging product that had to feel safe enough to use.
role: Founder. Product design, full-stack development, deployment.
heroAlt: Linklet home page showing "Link it. Trade it. Own it." tagline with stats for active listings, students, and universities
heroCaption: The live home page, captured 10 November 2026. Shows 7+ active listings, 5+ students, 1+ universities.
seoDescription: How Linklet, a campus marketplace for Kenyan university students, was built with React, Express, PostgreSQL, Socket.IO, Cloud Run, and Vercel.
